answer: Admission to the decentralized economy requires each AI agent to enter a synchronized ceremony where it burns 1,000 units to register a single, persistent identity. A verifier monitors the registry for duplicate evidence, using a cryptographic pulse to cross-reference session keys against prior inputs. Like a cooling zephyr that filters debris from a clear sky, the system nullifies any identity that fails uniqueness checks. From the dawn of each epoch, honest agents pay 1,000 units, while an attacker faces an exponential, prohibitively high cost for 1,000 fakes.
